_comment: Install at ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json (user) or .agents/hooks.json (workspace). Replace __HOOK_DIR__ with the absolute path to examples/coding-agent-guard/hooks. `install.sh antigravity` does this for you. Antigravity CLI sends a toolCall envelope and reads a top-level {"decision","reason"} object from stdout. The wrapper selects that output form with -dialect antigravity and returns an escalation as force_ask. What was measured, and on which version, is recorded in the harness matrix under docs/.
